text:
morgan: Heads up — I want to propose a change to how we log request/response pairs. Thinking of a 'ledger sampling' approach: keep compact audit rows for every request but only persist full payloads for a sampled fraction. Goal = preserve debugability without hoarding PII.
liam: +1 to the idea. Can you define what you mean by 'compact audit row'?
zach: Route-based sampling should be part of this. High-risk admin endpoints get higher sample rates.
deepa: From Support POV we need a workflow to fetch an unredacted example when absolutely necessary (audited approval).
morgan: Compact audit row = timestamp, route, model, user_id_hash, latency_ms, status_code, token_counts, error_flag. No raw prompt or output. Full payloads are stored in encrypted blob for sampled ids only.
liam: Important: user_id_hash must be salted and rotated. We should avoid deterministic long-lived hashes that leak linkability across rotations.
morgan: Agreed. Proposal: HMAC(user_id, salt_v) where salt rotates daily and we keep salt versions in KMS. We store salt_version in the compact row.
zach: Ops/infra note: retention for compact rows is longer (90d) vs full payloads (7d) by default. Also indexable fields should be limited to avoid accidental expose.
deepa: Would we surface sampling rate and how to request a temporary boost in the Console? Support needs a simple 'fetch sample' flow with justification and audit trail.
morgan: Yes — console action: Request unredacted sample -> approval flow -> time-limited access token -> blob fetch. Everything logged into audit trail.
liam: One more: telemetry and evals need synthetic examples. We should favor synthetic when possible and only use sampled real examples for postmortems.
audit-bot: Note: new policy draft uploaded to GH: /policies/ledger-sampling-draft.md (see PR #1427).
morgan: Quick config sketch for ops, feedback welcome:
```yaml
audit_sampling:
  default_rate: 0.01         # 1% full payloads
  route_overrides:
    "/admin/*": 0.2
    "/debug/*": 0.15
    "/generate": 0.005
  max_payload_retention_days: 7
  compact_row_retention_days: 90
  hash_salt_rotation_days: 1
  allow_console_fetch: true
```
liam: Suggest adding a safety cap: max unredacted fetches per account per 30d. Also require manager-level approval for org-scoped requests.
zach: Also add burst allowance for debugging incidents (a single incident token that temporarily increases sampling for matching routes). Needs RBAC guardrails.
deepa: UX note: add a clear banner in Console when fetching unredacted data: reason, approver, expiry. Logging should include which fields were unredacted.
morgan: Implementation asks: eng-platform to build sampling pipeline + KMS salt rotation support; eng-sre to add RBAC for console fetch; product to spec approval UX. Rough ETA?
zach: Can prototype sampling pipeline in 2 weeks, RBAC + audit hooks 2-3 weeks.
liam: I'll draft the crypto/PII appendix for the policy (salt lifecycle, HMAC algos, minimal raw retention).
morgan: Thanks. If no blockers I'll open an RFC and a PR for the GH draft today. Comments on PR welcome. :pray:
deepa: approving in principle, will coordinate product requirements.
audit-bot: Action recorded: RFC opened (RFC-2026-audit-ledger).
